label: Manor house
notes: a stone hall for the steward: rents are collected in full and the yard can be held

label: Mill
notes: a water or wind mill: the manor grinds its own grain and takes a toll on its neighbours'

label: Granary
notes: a stone granary: the harvest keeps, and a bad year is survived

label: Chapel
notes: a chapel with its own priest: the pulpit speaks well of the house that built it

label: Palisade
notes: a ditch and timber wall around the yard: a raid has to work for it

label: Market
notes: a weekly market by charter: tolls and stall rents
